sections.prose: - Mira Vale serves as the keeper of the archive situated beneath the eastern observatory. She maintains the security of the collection and oversees the preservation of its contents.

Mira manages the archive's daily operations, which include a ritual of checking the copper locks every morning before the arrival of visitors. The archive records do not contain information regarding her childhood.
Mira seeks to restore the damaged tide charts held within the archive.
* Checking the copper locks before the day's visitors arrive.
- Mira Vale serves as the keeper of the archive situated beneath the eastern observatory. She maintains the security of the collection and manages the preservation of its contents.
Mira oversees the daily operations of the archive. Each morning, she performs a ritual of checking the copper locks to ensure the integrity of the vault before the arrival of visitors.
Mira is driven by the desire to restore the damaged tide charts held within her care.
Mira works within the [Eastern Archive](01 Lore/Eastern Archive.md) as its primary keeper.
* Checking the copper locks every morning before visitors arrive.
